ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (cyan-white) to low-intensity (dark pigment and shadow) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity regions across the central lobes; low-intensity irregular mottling along the trailing edge and midline; vertical linear low-intensity markings on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 75 degrees; depth is roughly 15% of the fluke's vertical extent in the frame.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude of variations ranges from 2 to 10 pixels, most pronounced on the right lobe distal section.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory fitted from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct sets of parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the upper interior regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on both lobes; visible irregular indentation/notch on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized specular highlights (lens flare/reflection) at the left fluke tip and along the lower ventral midline.
